claims.statement: 低阈值 T 型钙电流 (IT, g=1.0, E=50, mvh=-65, τ=20ms) 介导 ca_rebound 世界的超极化后反弹放电
predicts: 在 depolarising conditioning + test 协议上，IT 因去极化期间部分失活，预测 spike 数 ≈ 26
在 brief hyperpol (40ms) + test 协议上，IT 预测 spike 数 ≈ 15
在 hyperpol pre-pulse + weak test 协议上，IT 预测 spike 数 ≈ 9.3
claims.conflicts: 与 H2(Ih) 在 long_step、brief hyperpol 协议上预测不同：IT 预测 long_step≈24，Ih 预测≈32

claims.statement: 超极化激活阳离子电流 (Ih, g=0.5, E=-30, mvh=-75, τ=50ms) 介导 ca_rebound 世界的超极化后反弹放电
predicts: 在 depolarising conditioning + test 协议上，Ih 因未失活且持续激活，预测 spike 数 ≈ 42
在 brief hyperpol (40ms) + test 协议上，Ih 因较慢激活时间常数(τ=50)在 40ms 内未充分激活，预测 spike 数 ≈ 19
在 hyperpol pre-pulse + weak test 协议上，Ih 预测 spike 数 ≈ 11
claims.conflicts: 与 H1(IT) 在 long_step、depolarising conditioning 协议上预测不同：Ih 预测 long_step≈32，IT 预测≈24

attacks.text: IT has fast inactivation kinetics (τ=20ms) - may not sustain rebound over long protocols. Observed: IT predicts long_step=24.0 vs observed 26.0, error 2.0.
Rebound could be mediated by persistent Na current (INaP) which also produces depolarization. INaP predicts brief_step=8.67, hyperpol_cond_depol=20.33, long_step=32.67 - worse fit than IT.
Ih has slower activation (τ=50ms) - may not activate sufficiently during brief protocols. Observed: Ih predicts long_step=31.7 vs observed 26.0, error 5.7 - much worse than IT's 2.0.
hyperpol_cond_depol shows Ih predicts 19.7 vs observed 19.3 - error of only 0.3, but this single good fit is outweighed by poor long_step fit.
